article.story: KALAMAZOO, Mich. -- — Ramere Draper’s 22 points off of the bench helped Western Michigan to a 104-52 victory against Grace Christian on Wednesday. Draper added five steals for the Broncos (6-1). Tanner Hayhurst scored 15 points, shooting 6 for 9, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc. Jaylen Washington shot 3 of 3 from the field and 3 for 3 from the line to finish with 10 points, while adding seven rebounds and three steals. Montrel Oliver finished with 10 points and two steals for the Tigers. Keaton Blanker added nine points and five assists for Grace Christian. Brad Coleman finished with eight points. Western Michigan took the lead with 15:28 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Augustinas Kiudulas scored all eight of his points in the first half to help put the Broncos up 44-24 at the break. Draper scored 16 points in the second half. Up next Western Michigan’s next game is Wednesday against Buffalo at home. Grace Christian (MI) visits Eastern Michigan on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
